blocks.text: Why analyzing fundraising campaign ROI is difficult

The core issue is a lack of a single, cohesive view of your supporters. When your CRM does not talk to your email platform or your payment processor, you end up with fragmented data. You spend more time matching rows in Excel than you do talking to donors. This is the admin tax that burns out even the most dedicated teams.
Common causes of poor fundraising analytics

items: Disconnected software tools that do not share data automatically.
Manual data entry leading to duplicate records and human error.
A focus on reactive trends from last year instead of predictive insights.
Inconsistent data access across different departments in your organization.
Over-reliance on quantitative metrics that ignore the emotional side of giving.

blocks.text: Practical fixes for better data management

You do not need a massive budget to improve your analytics. Start by cleaning your house. Audit your existing data sources to find duplicates. If you use Salesforce NPSP, DonorPerfect, or Neon CRM, ensure you are using their built-in reporting tools before building custom spreadsheets. Define your goals first, such as increasing donor retention, so you only collect the data that matters.
Using your Mac for better fundraising workflows

Since most fundraising platforms are browser-based, your Mac is a powerful tool for this work. Use Safari or Chrome to access your CRM. Use Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for quick analysis. When you feel stuck, use Lazur to help you navigate these apps faster.

faq.question: How can I start analyzing fundraising campaign ROI without expensive software?
faq.answer: Start by exporting your donation data into Google Sheets or Excel. Focus on calculating the cost per dollar raised for each campaign. Compare this against your donor retention rates to see which campaigns bring in long-term supporters.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with my CRM?
faq.answer: Lazur works with any app you use on your Mac, including web-based CRMs like Salesforce, DonorPerfect, or Neon CRM. It does not integrate directly with their internal databases, but it can guide you through their interfaces.

faq.question: Is it safe to use Lazur with donor data?
faq.answer: Lazur only sees your screen and hears your audio while you hold the activation shortcut. This information is not stored or used to train AI models. Always follow your organization's internal privacy and data security policies when handling donor information.
